FORESIGHT FALCONS IN EVERY BAY

Introducing
Foresight Falcon.

Installed in all six bays

Our newest overhead launch monitor delivers a massive hitting area with the utmost shot-measuring accuracy and reliability, courtesy of the same Quadrascopic Technology found in the award-winning GCQuad. The smaller form factor still captures nearly twice the measured data parameters of competitive overhead launch monitors.
